description: Royal Jordanian Royal Club Award Miles and segments for Royal Jordanian flights. Award Miles = distance x a % set by the fare family (fam: Economy Saver, Economy Plus, Economy Flexi, Business Saver, Business Plus, Business Flexi) and the tier (Bronze Sunbird 50% to 200%, up to Platinum Hawk 125% to 275%), rounded down, no minimum. Each flight counts 1 segment (0.5 between Amman and Aqaba or Tel Aviv, which needs from and to). Set noearn to Y for an award ticket or one at a 50% discount or more (earns nothing). Tier Miles are not calculated. Progress toward Silver Jay (14 segments), Gold Sparrow (30) and Platinum Hawk (46) in 12 months; qs is the segments so far. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Royal Jordanian's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium); ba-club = British Airways Club (creditStatus one of: Blue, Bronze, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

fam.description: Fare family. ES = Economy Saver (Economy, classes O, P, W); EP = Economy Plus (Economy, classes L, V, S, N, Q); EF = Economy Flexi (Economy, classes Y, B, H, K, M); BS = Business Saver (Business, classes I, Z); BP = Business Plus (Business, classes C, D); BF = Business Flexi (Business, classes J). The fare family on your Royal Jordanian ticket. The booking classes shown are as listed in Royal Jordanian's Tier Miles table; its Award Miles table names the families without letters, so the match is by family name (our reading).

noearn.description: Is it an award ticket or a ticket at a 50% discount or more?. N = No; Y = Yes (earns nothing). Royal Jordanian says these tickets earn no Award Miles or Tier Miles. Choose No if you do not know.

qs.description: Segments you have in the last 12 months (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next Royal Club tier. Amman-Aqaba and Amman-Tel Aviv count half.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your Royal Club tier. BR = Bronze Sunbird; SI = Silver Jay (+25 points); GO = Gold Sparrow (+50 points); PL = Platinum Hawk (+75 points). The tier is built into the percentage: each step up adds 25 points to the fare family's percentage.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
